$comment: What is released: the extensions a release packs and lists (npm run pack:extensions; an installer bundles none, scripts/after-pack.cjs drops them all) and what scripts/export-release.cjs copies into the public repo. Add a plugin, and any service only it uses, when you release it. The system services (audio, wallpaper) are part of Core (core/system) and always go with it; Location and Now Playing are official services, installed with what uses them.
